name: Santa Bárbara de Casa (Spain)
description: Blue field with a vertical band of white, red and white towards the hoist, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Santa Bárbara de Casa (a tower on red).
history: Municipal flag of Santa Bárbara de Casa; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: vertical band of white, red and white towards the hoist
